brief:
Palestinian prisoner advocacy organizations mourned Fathi Khazem on Friday after Israeli forces killed him during a raid on his home in Jenin, Shehab Wire reported. The organizations alleged that occupation forces executed Khazem during the early morning operation. Khazem was the father of imprisoned daughter Shimaa Khazem and two sons, Raad and Abdulrahman Khazem, both of whom were killed in previous incidents.

The raid unfolded in the northern West Bank city as Israeli military units entered the residential compound. Prisoner rights groups have characterized the operation as an extrajudicial killing, adding Khazem's name to a growing list of Palestinians killed in Israeli military operations across the occupied territories.
